decision: window-geometry persistence keys are five ScalarSettings fields: window_x/window_y/window_width/window_height: Option<f32> (the normal-mode frame in screen points, all None until a frontend saves a placement) and window_maximized: bool; full screen is deliberately not persisted
why: None x4 is what makes "never persisted yet" representable, so a store the nsh frontend never met keeps the frontend's launch default; the shape mirrors the row's typed columns per the struct's own doc contract

decision: the geometry's write path rides the existing frame-end diff-commit: Preferences carries a WindowGeometry handoff value (seeded by hydrate from the loaded row, updated by Preferences::set_window_geometry), and scalar_settings gains a window parameter so the one canonical builder writes the whole row including geometry; the sessions never learn about the window
why: commit_if_changed is the only scalar writer and its diff already lands session mutations; a second save path would race it, and filling the geometry columns with defaults in scalar_settings would clobber the row on every settings commit

decision: restore runs at the shell's mount: placement_of turns a full row into an nsh WindowPlacement and set_placement puts the window back (the framework's own restore API, which fits the frame onto the displays there are now); a size-only row falls back to set_bounds; AppOptions' (1200, 800) stays the fallback when the row is empty. The save side is an nsh effect reading current_window().state() (a settled-frame report), comparing against the last seen placement and calling set_window_geometry; no signal is written and the pump's next tick commits it
why: Windows has no pre-open geometry hook reachable without composing the runtime in main.rs (out of the authorized files), and the component body runs before the first frame commits; the effect + diff-commit reuses the one save path
evidence: docs/execution-plans/evidence/nsh/n4/logs/n4-drive.log (restored frame L=120 T=90 W=1000 H=700); crates/riff-gui-nsh/src/shell/layout.rs; tests/nsh_shell_tests.rs the_shell_persists_its_window_frame_through_the_settings_commit + the_shell_restores_the_persisted_frame_at_launch

decision: caption-button duplication (P0 correction 23, the phase's live question): under TitleBarStyle::Hidden the platform DOES draw its own minimize/maximize/close inside the reserved title_bar().right region, and they work (double-click on the drag region maximizes, the system buttons carry minimize out); the shell therefore draws NO custom window controls and keeps .pr(title_bar().right + padding) as the only reservation
why: The system buttons are native, correctly placed and themed for the window's appearance; custom duplicates render side by side with them (first drive pass), and nsh exposes no suppression knob in WindowAttributes/TitleBarOptions; deleting the custom set is the smallest change that matches the platform's idiom
